character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Pedder Road does not announce itself. There are no neon signs, no crowded markets, no honking auto-rickshaws. The streets are wide and tree-lined. The buildings are set back from the road. The residents move quietly and purposefully. This is a neighbourhood that has always known exactly what it is - and has never needed to prove it to anyone. Old Parsi families, Gujarati industrialists, Sindhi business dynasties and a new generation of tech billionaires all call Pedder Road home. The Breach Candy Club is the social anchor. Jaslok and Breach Candy hospitals are the healthcare anchors. Campion and Cathedral are the school anchors. Everything here is the best of its kind - and the residents expect nothing less.

faq.question: What is Pedder Road known for?
faq.answer: Pedder Road is known for being one of Mumbai's most exclusive and prestigious residential addresses, home to Kemps Corner, Breach Candy, Cumballa Hill and Napeansea Road. It is synonymous with old money, heritage bungalows, luxury high-rises, the Breach Candy Club and some of Mumbai's finest hospitals and schools.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Pedder Road?
faq.answer: Pedder Road has the pin code 400026. The adjacent Breach Candy and Kemps Corner areas also use 400026, while Napeansea Road uses 400006.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Pedder Road?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Pedder Road are Kemps Corner, Breach Candy, Cumballa Hill, Warden Road, Napeansea Road, August Kranti Marg, Altamount Road, and the Malabar Hill fringe.

faq.question: What is the property price in Pedder Road?
faq.answer: Property prices in Pedder Road are among Mumbai's highest - ranging from ₹5 Cr for a 2BHK in Kemps Corner to ₹10–25 Cr for a 3BHK on Pedder Road/Breach Candy, and ₹25 Cr+ for premium Napeansea Road and Altamount Road bungalows and penthouses. Rental rates range from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh+ per month (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Pedder Road?
faq.answer: Pedder Road is primarily served by taxis and private cars. The nearest Western Railway stations are Grant Road (15 min walk) and Charni Road (15 min walk). BEST bus routes 1, 83, 106, 132 serve the area. The Bandra-Worli Sea Link is accessible via Haji Ali, and the Eastern Freeway via Mahalaxmi.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Pedder Road?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Pedder Road include Breach Candy Hospital, Jaslok Hospital, Wockhardt Hospital, Saifee Hospital, and Hinduja Hospital (nearby Mahim).

faq.question: Which schools are in Pedder Road?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Pedder Road include Campion School, Cathedral & John Connon School, Walsingham House School, St. Anne's High School, and Greenlawns High School.
